_comment: COMEDY ATLAS ticket-referral config (D1, docs/ATLAS_ROADMAP_DECISIONS_2026-07-16.md). Single source of truth for go.html's outbound-redirect allowlist + affiliate params. Read at click time by go.html AND by scripts/atlas_ticket_clicks_report.py's tests -- keep both in sync by editing this one file, no regeneration step needed. ALLOWED_TICKET_HOSTS is derived from every hostname actually present in exports/upcoming_events.json's canonical_event_url column as of 2026-07-16 (eventbrite.com/.fr, freefestival.co.uk, freefringe.org.uk) plus meetup.com (an active collector target, see pipeline/registry.py, not yet appearing in live data). 2026-07-19 (ADR-021, organizer trust extended to EVENT_ADDITION): eventbrite.de and comedycafe.nl added -- the first live ticket-URL hosts from the newly organizer-trusted Berlin/Munich Eventbrite feeds and an Amsterdam club's own official ticketing site, surfaced by tests/test_atlas_partner_config.py against the freshly regenerated live export. 2026-07-19 (migration 0097, Dublin default_language backfill): eventbrite.ie added -- the first live ticket-URL host from Hysteria Comedy Club / the Comedy Nomad / The Laughter Factory's Dublin Eventbrite listings, now publishable once those orgs' default_language stopped sitting NULL; surfaced the same way by the same test. 2026-07-19 (close-out batch, item 1): eventbrite.be and eventbrite.ca added -- both already present in the live regenerated exports/upcoming_events.json (Brussels and a Canadian Eventbrite feed) and flagged missing by test_every_ticket_url_host_in_live_export_is_allowlisted; same trusted Eventbrite platform as every other eventbrite.* entry already on this list, just new country TLDs. 2026-07-26 (F0, REVENUE_READINESS_AUDIT_2026-07-26.md): the first FOUR self-ticketing club hosts added -- newyorkcomedyclub.com (21 events), ccu.stageti.me (Comedy Corner Underground Minneapolis, 21), eastvillecomedy.com (20), thetinycupboard.com (15). These four US rooms were onboarded and published earlier the same day WITHOUT this step, so go.html's fail-closed host check refused all 77 of their ticket links -- 100% of the US expansion was listed but unbuyable. test_every_ticket_url_host_in_live_export_is_allowlisted had been failing and was not read. US clubs self-ticket on their own domains rather than through Eventbrite, so unlike every earlier entry this list will now grow with EVERY new US room: adding the host is a MANDATORY step of the venue-onboarding recipe, not an afterthought. Add a host here BEFORE it can appear as a working ticket link -- this is a safety allowlist, not a discovery mechanism. 2026-08-16 (affiliate-loop audit): skiddle.com (approved param partner, ATLAS_AFF_SKIDDLE) plus the 11 stubhub.* and 4 viagogo.* hosts (AWIN network-redirect partner, ATLAS_AFF_STUBHUB/_MID) added -- ingest/ticket_partners.py had registered all 15 since commit 4ac6999 but scripts/sync_ticket_partner_params.py only computes PARTNER_PARAMS/PARTNER_REDIRECTS for hosts already in this list, so the registry entries were silently inert. Allowlisting alone does not grant an affiliate id: StubHub/viagogo remain a plain passthrough until Robert supplies ATLAS_AFF_STUBHUB/_MID (blocked on the AWIN programme's merchant id). 2026-10-03 (Robert approved the Ticketmaster Discovery API): the Ticketmaster-owned storefronts that API actually returns for comedy in 26 countries were added (ticketmaster.* country sites, universe.com, ticketweb.com/.ca, moshtix.com.au/.co.nz, biletix.com), read from a live sample of 200 events per country, not guessed. Plain passthrough: no Ticketmaster affiliate id is held yet. Venue-own hosts the sample also showed (rmts.bc.ca, werklundcentre.ca, theboxoffice.ca, my.winspearcentre.com, gofevo.com, showpass.com, admitone.com, travel/theatre.ticketmaster subdomains) were deliberately NOT added. 2026-10-04 00:40: the daily publish's ticket-host preflight refused the whole batch because 70 exact venue/ticketing hosts returned by the Ticketmaster Discovery API (theatre./comedy./travel.ticketmaster, etix, axs, ticketweb.uk, *.evenue.net, venue box-office sites ...) were not listed. Added as EXACT hosts only (no wildcards). Read from the refused batch itself, not guessed. Follow-up: a single unlisted host blocks the entire publish; the loader should allowlist trusted-source hosts automatically or drop only the affected links.

PARTNER_PARAMS._comment: '*' applies to every outbound host; a bare hostname key applies only to that host and is merged over '*'. Populated from approved affiliate_programs rows (Skiddle, partner_id 15788, approved 2026-08-19) -- go.html reads this file at click time, so no page regeneration is needed when a deal changes. Every host with a non-empty block here MUST have disclosure text in PARTNER_DISCLOSURES; tests enforce it.

PARTNER_DISCLOSURES._comment: Disclosure shown by go.html when, and only when, the money layer actually acts on that destination (a non-empty PARTNER_PARAMS block or a PARTNER_REDIRECTS wrap). Text is copied from affiliate_programs.disclosure_text for each approved programme -- that column is the source of truth and is CHECK-constrained to exist for any approved row. '*' is the fallback for an earning host with no host-specific text.
PARTNER_DISCLOSURES.skiddle.com: COMEDY ATLAS may earn a commission on tickets purchased through this Skiddle link, at no extra cost to you.
